void_spirit_intrinsic_edge.name: Intrinsic Edge
void_spirit_intrinsic_edge.description: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

void_spirit_aether_remnant.name: Aether Remnant
void_spirit_aether_remnant.description: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
void_spirit_aether_remnant.shard_description: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.
void_spirit_aether_remnant.lore: Inai exists not in a single point of space and time.

void_spirit_dissimilate.name: Dissimilate
void_spirit_dissimilate.description: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
void_spirit_dissimilate.facet_void_spirit_aether_artifice: Upon exiting Dissimilate, Aether Remnants are created at the %aether_remnant_count% portals furthest from Void Spirit. No effect if reassembling from the center portal. Remnants face towards the center portal and have reduced pull duration and damage.
void_spirit_dissimilate.lore: Inai prefers to observe our world without burdening himself with a material form.
void_spirit_dissimilate.note0: Aether Remnant copies do not appear in the outer ring with Call of the Void aspect.
void_spirit_dissimilate.burst_description: After a short delay, creates a Dissimilate explosion at the target point.

void_spirit_resonant_pulse.name: Resonant Pulse
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.description: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.facet_void_spirit_sanctuary: Resonant Pulse creates a larger all damage barrier instead of a physical barrier.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.scepter_description: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.lore: Inai shelters himself in his true form when he must engage with the mortal world.

void_spirit_astral_step.name: Astral Step
void_spirit_astral_step.description: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
void_spirit_astral_step.note0: Attacks from this ability do not deal cleave damage.
void_spirit_astral_step.lore: A single step by Inai brings devastation to the mortal realm.
